title: oh f**k me
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: 10-year yields are rising at a slowing pace and should peak around 5.27%; the 'suits' calling for 6% on the 30-year are likely wrong.
Heavy Treasury and corporate issuance is pushing repo rates up and draining cash, which means more volatility and buy-the-dip chances rather than a crisis.
The 10s2s spread at 52bp puts markets in shock-prone territory.
Strike-plan leaks are negotiation; he expects Trump to fire no missiles before the election and to seek a win between Oct 20-27.
It is a bubble, but the party is just getting started.

calls.condition: If he is wrong, the next logical high for the 10-year is ~5.6% (TLT losing its 78.77 line with ~5% more downside, as in 2023).
calls.reason: Rise in the 10-year is decelerating over the last five days; he anchors the peak around 5.27% and expects yields to come down, as they did intraday; disagrees with calls for 30-year yields to test 6%.
calls.quote: my thought has been that we anchor around 5.27 and that the slope or the acceleration of the rise in the 10-year Treasury is actually …

calls.condition: Bullish view rests on yields peaking; volatility likely with 10s2s spread at 52bp (shock-prone above 50).
calls.reason: Yields down means stocks up; AI-buildout financing will be covered by more debt so the bubble keeps inflating; expects no US strikes on Iran before the election.
calls.quote: we expect that this is a bubble, but we think the party is still just getting started

notes: Date: the Bloomberg piece he reads says 30-year yields hit fresh highs 'on Wednesday', which he ties to that morning's alpha report, and he signs off 'have a wonderful evening' → recorded Wednesday 2026-10-07 after the close (listing approx_date 2026-10-08). Video is mostly a 'how could I be wrong' discussion; 5.6% is his bear-case level, not his target. 30-year view (5.72% touched; he agrees yields rising but decelerating, rejects 6% call) folded into TNX reason rather than a separate TYX call. Sponsor/ad segments ignored.
